structured.answer: Joining is clearly worth it: I put in 750 ₪ a month and the employer adds 2,250 ₪. But if I take it out at 5 years a big chunk (−64,761 ₪) goes, leaving 136,457 ₪, so I'd join and not touch it for 6 years.

stuck.where: Waterfall chart under 'מושכים את הכסף אחרי 5 שנים'
stuck.why: The −64,761 ₪ red striped bar isn't labelled in words, and the final 136,457 ₪ is less than 45,000 + 135,000, so I had to guess it's tax for early withdrawal

stuck.where: Small text block after the chart (135,908 עד 137,668, 15,712 ₪, 47%)
stuck.why: Too dense; I couldn't tell whether my 30,000 salary is fully counted or capped
I never saw my 30,000 in a field. It fell between screenshots, so I only trusted the 750/2,250 line

used: Heading קרן השתלמות and first lines of מה זה (6 years tax-free)
Label 'לפני 6 שנים: מס' / 'מ־6 שנים: פטור עד התקרה'
skimmed: Small text after the chart (19 מסלולים, 135,908–137,668)
unsure_meaning: Pink striped bar segments in the chart
Yellow vs teal colours (guessed employer money vs profit)
15,712 ₪ ceiling and how it affects a 30,000 salary
not_found: A plain statement of how much I get if I wait 6+ years

findings.what: Big red '−64,761 ₪' with no word saying what it is; scary, and the end result looks smaller than what was paid in
Default view shows withdrawal at 5 years (taxed), so the first result I see is the bad case, not the 6-year tax-free one
Salary ceiling 15,712 ₪ is buried in small text; with a 30,000 salary I can't tell what part counts
findings.where: Small text under chart, screen 4; מיסוי, screen 7

findings.what: Chart colours not explained next to the bars
Fees only in percent (0.54%, עד 2%), never in shekels
Lots of jargon and little tags (חוקים וכללים · N) that clutter the text
Company names listed without guidance on which to pick
findings.where: מי מציע ומי מפקח, כמה זה עולה
